mainPage.name: AccessVaulted Username & Password Generator
mainPage.description: Free online tool to generate secure random usernames and passwords with customizable options

mainEntity.name: Is this generator really free with no limits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, completely free with no usage limits. Generate unlimited usernames and passwords without registration or payment.

mainEntity.name: Are my generated credentials stored anywhere?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. All generation happens in your browser. We never see, receive, or store any credentials you generate.

mainEntity.name: What makes this better than creating passwords manually?

acceptedAnswer.text: Manual passwords often contain predictable patterns. Our generator uses cryptographic randomness for true unpredictability and security.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this for business or commercial purposes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Many businesses use our generator for employee accounts, test environments, and secure credential management.
